title: Transitions
summary: GPU shader transitions between two shots, shown going from the sample clip to a graphics frame. Comic-panel moves with cream gutters and ink lines, plus sun, brush and print dissolves in the theme colours.
usage: On a shot (the transition INTO it from the shot before): {"transition": {"name": "panel_slide", "seconds": 0.6}}. In a footage storyboard, at a cut such as the start of a full-screen cutaway: "transitions": [{"name": "panel_wipe", "at": 7.8, "seconds": 0.5}]. Engine: library/_shared/shader_transitions.py (moderngl).

items.name: panel wipe
items.description: An angled comic-panel edge crosses the frame: ink line, thick cream gutter, ink line, with the next shot behind it.

items.name: panel slide
items.description: The next shot arrives as four angled panels sliding in from alternating sides, each with a cream gutter and ink outline.

items.name: page turn
items.description: The page lifts from the bottom corner, curls over as pale paper and peels away to the shot underneath.

items.name: sunset blinds
items.description: Angled slats flip over one after another, showing strips of sunset between them as they turn.

items.name: slice slide
items.description: Horizontal strips slide off to alternate sides.

items.name: swing doors
items.description: The picture splits down the middle and swings open like doors.

items.name: sun burn
items.description: A sun disc grows from a point and burns through: ink rim, pink, orange, yellow, white-hot, then the next shot.

items.name: ink swipe
items.description: A loaded brush drags a pink-to-yellow band across behind a ragged ink edge.

items.name: halftone dissolve
items.description: Ink-rimmed dots on a print screen grow from one corner until they join.

items.name: luma melt
items.description: The picture runs down the frame like wet paint, bright areas first.

items.name: zoom through
items.description: A fast push through the middle of one shot into the next.
